name: presentation-structure
tagline_zh: 做PPT总在排版和逻辑间反复横跳？这个Skill直接给你一套导航与权重系统，让每页都自动找到自己的位置。
tagline_en: Stop wrestling with slide logic. This skill hands you a navigation & weight system so every page knows its place.
desc_en: Knowledge about the presentation slide format, weight system, navigation, and section structure
why_zh: 同类只给模板，它给的是结构规则——像骨架师一样，先定导航和权重，再填内容，逻辑自然成型。
why_en: Others give templates; this one gives structural rules—navigation & weight first, so content falls into place logically.
